en_title: GTA 6 Will Do Something the Franchise Has Never Done Before: Encourage Empathy
cn_title: 《GTA6》将做到系列从未做到过的事：鼓励共情
opus_summary: Rockstar联合工作室负责人Rob Nelson表示，《GTA6》首次在系列中加入鼓励同理心的机制，玩家的行动将影响游戏进程。玩家仍可制造混乱，也可以选择友善行事。游戏将于2026年11月19日登陆PS5和XBOX Series X | S。

paragraphs.en: Rockstar has confirmed GTA 6 features something the franchise has never had before: mechanisms that encourage empathy.
paragraphs.cn: Rockstar已确认，《GTA6》将加入系列此前从未有过的内容：鼓励共情的机制。

paragraphs.en: Co-studio head Rob Nelson and head of publishing Jennifer Kolbe talked about how next week's Grand Theft Auto changes the formula the series is known for during an interview with The Guardian (via @GameRoll_ ). Jason and Lucia will surely be able to cause a fair amount of chaos when players take control in Vice City, but in a post- Red Dead Redemption 2 world, they'll have the freedom to be kind, too.
paragraphs.cn: 联合工作室负责人Rob Nelson和发行负责人Jennifer Kolbe在接受《卫报》采访时，谈到了下周推出的《侠盗猎车手》将如何改变该系列为人熟知的模式（消息经由@GameRoll_）。当玩家在Vice City操控Jason和Lucia时，他们肯定能够制造相当多的混乱，但在《荒野大镖客：救赎2》问世之后，他们也将拥有行善的自由。

paragraphs.en: "Crime is a fundamental part of GTA – at least up until now, it has been," Nelson said. "We're trying to make sure we're not punishing people for playing the game they are used to … [but] your actions will have some effect on how the game plays out."
paragraphs.cn: Nelson说：「犯罪是《侠盗猎车手》的基本组成部分——至少到目前为止一直如此。我们正在努力确保不会因为玩家按照他们习惯的方式玩游戏而惩罚他们……［但］你的行为将对游戏的进程产生一定影响。」

paragraphs.en: Games like GTA 5 have given players playgrounds and characters that can maximize the mayhem. Trevor, one of that game's three protagonists, is a great example of this chaotic energy, but in GTA 6, there doesn't seem to be a direct equivalent. Sure, Rockstar's trademark tone and instantly recognizable characters can be seen all over what few trailers we've received thus far, but everything seems a bit more grounded, too.
paragraphs.cn: 《GTA5》等游戏为玩家提供了可以最大限度制造混乱的游乐场和角色。该游戏的三位主角之一Trevor就是这种混乱活力的绝佳例子，但《GTA6》中似乎没有与之直接对应的角色。当然，在迄今公布的为数不多的预告片中，Rockstar标志性的基调和一眼就能认出的角色随处可见，但一切似乎也更加贴近现实。

paragraphs.en: Falling in line with this is the news that GTA 6 will feature a world that might actually reward those who take the citizens of Leonida into consideration. Of course, that doesn't mean those who prefer to wreak havoc won't be able to play their way, too. It just means that, at least based on Nelson's words, there's some room to be a normal or even good person, too.
paragraphs.cn: 与此相符的消息是，《GTA6》将呈现一个或许真的会奖励那些顾及Leonida居民的玩家的世界。当然，这并不意味着喜欢大肆破坏的玩家不能按照自己的方式游玩。这只是意味着，至少根据Nelson的话，玩家也有一定空间做一个普通人，甚至是好人。

paragraphs.en: "I would say so," he replied when asked if the new game would encourage empathy in some capacity. "I would say that it's a product of the story we're trying to tell. We've tried for the first time in a GTA to provide mechanisms that encourage it, for those who want to."
paragraphs.cn: 当被问及新游戏是否会在某种程度上鼓励共情时，他回答说：「我会这么说。我认为这是我们试图讲述的故事的产物。我们首次尝试在《侠盗猎车手》游戏中提供鼓励共情的机制，让有意愿的人使用。」

paragraphs.en: Elsewhere in the interview, Nelson described Jason and Lucia as a "younger couple with their backs against the wall," which is why it doesn't make sense for them to "go out and cause as much carnage and make as much noise as they can." This isn't Michael, Franklin, or Trevor, nor is it Niko Bellic. Thankfully, we won't have to wait too much longer to find out just what kind of criminals Jason and Lucia are, or who they can be.
paragraphs.cn: 在采访的其他部分，Nelson将Jason和Lucia描述为「一对走投无路的年轻情侣」，因此，让他们「跑出去尽可能大开杀戒、制造动静」并不合理。他们不是Michael、Franklin或Trevor，也不是Niko Bellic。值得庆幸的是，我们不必再等太久，就能知道Jason和Lucia究竟是什么样的罪犯，或者他们可以成为什么样的人。

paragraphs.en: GTA 6 launches November 19, 2026, for PS5 and Xbox Series X | S. With more grounded in-game mechanisms and NPCs that react to weapons, it's clear we're staring down what will likely be the most realistic Grand Theft Auto game so far. It's something that has plenty of fans excited and others nervous . Recent footage shared by Rockstar has highlighted the game's unbelievable graphics . It's something that has IGN writer Jacqueline Thomas excited , even if it does run at 30 fps .
paragraphs.cn: 《GTA6》将于2026年11月19日登陆PS5和XBOX Series X | S。凭借更加贴近现实的游戏内机制以及会对武器作出反应的NPC，显然，我们即将迎来的很可能是迄今最真实的《侠盗猎车手》游戏。这让不少粉丝感到兴奋，也让另一些人感到紧张。Rockstar最近分享的画面突显了这款游戏令人难以置信的画质。这让IGN作者Jacqueline Thomas感到兴奋，即便游戏的运行帧率确实是30 fps。
